US Official Highlights India's AI Edge Over China

A top US official has stated that India's engineering talent gives it an advantage over China in the field of Artificial Intelligence. The official noted that only India can rival China in terms of its engineering workforce and talent pool. This statement comes amid expanding cooperation in AI between India and the United States.
